environment.description: Application deployed in ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAF WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode (not block), (2) A custom rule group 'app-input-validation' with a single rule that uses a RegexPatternSet matching on the query string component with pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|(?:\'|\")--)` in BLOCK mode with priority 1, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress except to the VPC endpoint for S3 (for logging). The task uses a read-only root filesystem with /var/lib/app mounted as an ephemeral tmpfs. CloudWatch Container Insights enabled with query-level logging.

config.task_role_egress: VPC endpoint for S3 only, no internet egress via NAT
config.monitoring: CloudWatch Container Insights, WAF logging to S3
